item.warlock.clerical_incense.tooltip: It's said that sleeping under this mixture's effects wards off night terrors.
item.warlock.incense_eternal.tooltip: A blend old as time, used by seekers of youth everlasting for millennia...
item.warlock.incense_fiend.tooltip: Smells of fire, brimstone, and blood...
item.warlock.incense_fey.tooltip: If you listen close, you hear faint birdsong and laughter...
item.warlock.incense_light.tooltip: It promises to enlighten, to purify, all it can see...
item.warlock.incense_machine.tooltip: The more ecclesiastical engineers swear by blends like this...
item.warlock.incense_masque.tooltip: You witness in its grain, good tidings...
item.warlock.incense_revenant.tooltip: The stench of rot and decay clings to this mixture...
item.warlock.incense_thing_outside.toolt: Even thinking about it makes you uneasy...
item.warlock.incense_star.tooltip: It feels as if it ought to carry the whimsical knowledge of the stars above...
item.warlock.incense_sword.tooltip: This is a focused thing, prepared to stimulate a razor-sharp mind...
item.warlock.incense_waves.tooltip: Smells of salt, fish, and the wide open sea...
item.warlock.incense_wish_tooltip: They say the vessel one puts this fortunate mix in matters more than the mix itself...
